"Any sport is better when you can enjoy it and play at your best capability."

Hello, my name is Mark Roterdam, founder and owner of Aspect Golf. When I created Aspect Golf, I set out on a mission to help golfers of all ages achieve their best scores and have more fun playing in the process.

Throughout years of researching and working on my own golf swing, I found that every coach has a teaching philosophy that's unique: some more complex, some simpler. That's been proven by the many great players who've learned this game differently, yet still arrive at the same place at impact.

The Aspect approach

Fewer compensations. A more repeatable swing.

There are many efficient ways to swing a golf club. I've studied swings from early champions like Harry Vardon, Ben Hogan, and Fred Couples, through to our most recent champions on tour: Tommy Fleetwood, Cameron Young, and Wyndham Clark. Players like John Daly and Jim Furyk don't share a cookie-cutter swing, because their fundamentals differ slightly, but the result at impact is nearly identical.

The modern swing has adapted because we now have the technology to measure efficiency: to see, in slow motion, how the club is taken away and brought back to impact. My experience teaching and learning has shown that by reducing the compensations made in the golf swing, we build an easier, more repeatable, and more consistent swing to play with.

I set every golfer up with a stock shot, the tools and drills to produce it, and a training schedule to make sure it sticks. Come learn to train and swing it like the pros.
